transcript.answer: Before 2026-09-23 the subsystem only rendered a recipe's `mcp_servers` for Claude, and gemini-cli has no MCP flag because it reads MCP servers from its settings. So Gemini pods had no Lore MCP at all, which is why the review runs made zero MCP calls. Subsystem v0.11.2 (lore #2133) tried to fix this. It wrote the servers to a system-scope settings file at `/agent/.ai-agent/gemini-settings.json`, pointed to by `GEMINI_CLI_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH`. gemini-cli refuses a system settings file unless its parent directory is root-owned, and the pod runs as uid 1000. It printed 'Security Warning: Skipping system settings file' and started with 'init … (0 tools)'. The fix came in subsystem v0.11.3 (lore #2144, subsystem #246). It merges the servers into the user settings file `/agent/.gemini/settings.json`. That was proven on 2026-09-23.

judgements.reason: The answer states that v0.11.2 wrote MCP servers to a system-scope settings file, that gemini-cli refused it for the uid-1000 pod, and that v0.11.3 moved them to the user settings at /agent/.gemini/settings.json; the extra pre-v0.11.2 context does not contradict the gold answer.
